title: —My ancestors threw off their language and took another Stephen said. They allowed a handful of foreigners to subject them. Do you fancy I am going to pay in my own life and person debts they made? What for?
html_source: Stephen refuses to allow himself to be defined by his past, as in Ulysses, he thinks: “History is a nightmare from which I am trying to awake.” However, the key word, “trying” means that despite Stephen’s hatred or disdain for his past, he will forever be tied to it. Here, Stephen rejects Irish nationalism because he finds it limiting in his expressions as an artist, and that he sees himself primarily as an individual. He refuses to be defined by the mistakes of his ancestors, yet it is their mistakes which have allowed Stephen to understand himself better as an artist.
